  ## What to build (in payment-platform)

  extend ProcessorHealthClient with merchant-scoped lookup, add DEGRADED enum + reason-code list, plumb scope through the existing health cache.

  ## Background (auto-snapshot from parent — do not edit)

  Today the processor-health endpoint reports a single global value per processor. Merchants cannot distinguish their own scope.

  **payment-platform impact**:
  - payment-platform: extend ProcessorHealthClient with merchant-scoped lookup, add DEGRADED enum + reason-code list, plumb scope through the existing health cache.

  ## Acceptance criteria

  - [ ] `GET /processor-health?merchantId=X` returns scoped data; integration test against the merchant-config fixture.
  - [ ] DEGRADED status returned when 5xx rate exceeds threshold; unit test on the reason-code mapper.
  - [ ] Cache key includes (processor, merchantId); existing cache hits unaffected; cache-stats unit test.
